text: Mithila Makhana, scientifically known as Euryale ferox, is a unique variety of aquatic fox nut cultivated in the Mithila region of Bihar state in India and in Nepal. In Mithila, it is also called Makhan and is one of the three key cultural identities of the region, alongside Pond and Fish (Maithili: पग-पग पोखरि, माछ, मखान). It is traditionally used in the Kojagara festival celebrated by Maithil Brahmins and Kaysaths for newly married couples. Bihar Agricultural University, Sabour, played a key role in securing a geographical indication (GI) tag for Mithila Makhana, which was officially granted in April 2022. This initiative was championed by Darbhanga MP Gopal Jee Thakur, who repeatedly demanded the GI tag in the Indian Parliament. The GI tag was registered in the name of Mithilanchal Makhana Utpadak Sangh, Purnia. The Indian Postal Department launched a courier service for delivering Mithila Makhana in Bihar from 28 January 2021. In recent years, Mithila Makhana has gained global popularity as a superfood; Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi referred to it as a superfood during a rally in Bhagalpur on 24 February 2025. Demand for makhana is rapidly rising in the western world, with the United States being the largest consumer and importer, followed by Canada and Australia. Makhana is recognized as "The Black Diamond," and India is the world’s largest exporter of the product. The Mithila region is the largest producer of makhana in India, accounting for 80 percent of the total cultivation in the country. On 24 February 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced that makhana should be made available globally. On 20 February 2025, Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced during the 2025 budget speech the establishment of a Makhana Board in Bihar, with the primary objectives of enhancing production, processing, value addition, and marketing of makhana from the Mithila region. On 23 February 2025, Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chauhan visited the Makhana Research Centre in Darbhanga to discuss the formation of the proposed Makhana Board with local farmers. On 24 February 2025, Prime Minister Narendra Modi reiterated the formation of the Makhana Board during his rally in Bhagalpur.
